name: Jissia
title: Levite and descendant of Izhar
summary: Jissia (also spelled Jishja or Jishia) is a person mentioned in 1 Chronicles who belonged to the Levitical lineage. He was a descendant of Izhar, son of Kohath, and is listed in the genealogical records of Levitical families who served in the temple during King David's organization of worship.

keyEvents.title: Mentioned in the Levitical lineage
keyEvents.description: Jissia is listed as part of Izhar's descendants among the Levites in 1 Chronicles, where the Levitical families are cataloged.

keyEvents.title: Organization of the Levites under David
keyEvents.description: As part of the Levitical lineage, Jissia and his family were organized by King David for service in the sanctuary.

keyEvents.title: Role of the Kohathite clan
keyEvents.description: Jissia belonged to the Kohathites, one of the three main branches of the tribe of Levi, who had special duties related to the service of the sanctuary.

keyEvents.title: Descendants of Izhar mentioned among the Levites
keyEvents.description: The branch of the Levites to which Jishar belonged, and to which Izzia also belonged, was assigned specific duties related to temple service and worship.
